PLAN "Cycle-Sensitive Strength Programme (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with cycle-aware adjustments"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Cycle Awareness" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
